name: work-suite
description: A lean workflow primitive for orchestrator agents: resolve material unknowns, plan only when needed, implement the smallest correct vertical slice, merge through terminal delivery, and keep authorized autopilot work moving.

interface.shortDescription: Ideation, planning, doing, merging, and autonomous execution skills.
interface.longDescription: Work Suite packages the canonical Ourostack workflow skills for Codex and other agent runtimes: work-ideator, work-planner, work-doer, work-merger, visual-qa-dogfood, autopilot, stay-in-turn, and inch-worm. Work Suite 2 plans only when needed, uses pinned upstream Ponytail for the smallest correct coding change, preserves risk-driven review and validation, and keeps authorized autopilot work moving through terminal delivery.
defaultPrompt: Run in autopilot through merge, deploy, smoke, cleanup, and durable continuation.
